title: The New Threat
summary: Mini Goku is Just Precious! I'm GohanWith no new battles to fight, Goku has been living a quiet life in the countryside with his wife Chi-chi and their son Gohan! While Goku makes plans to spend a happy day with friends on Master Roshi's island, a powerful new threat is on its way to Earth. And the arrival of this sinister alien could spell disaster for Goku and his friends!

title: Reunions
summary: The Strongest Warrior in All of History is Goku's Brother!Goku and Gohan attend a reunion on Master Roshi's island, where Goku introduces his son to all of his old friends. The smiles quickly fade, however, as an unexpected visitor lands on the island, and for Goku the day becomes a reunion of a different kind. A powerful alien has arrived. It's Raditz, Goku's evil older brother!

title: Unlikely Alliance
summary: Alright! This is the Strongest Combo on Earth!Raditz has kidnapped Gohan! And unless Goku agrees to forsake his friends and the people of Earth by joining the sinister Saiyan, he may never see his son again! All hope is not lost, however, as a second uninvited guest arrives on the island and Goku forges an unlikely alliance!

title: Piccolo's Plan
summary: Piccolo's Trump Card! Gohan is a CrybabyThe situation looks bleak for Goku and Piccolo, as Raditz easily deflects every attack they send his way. But Piccolo may have a way to stop the sinister Saiyan. He's perfected a powerful new attack... the Special Beam Cannon! There's only one problem. Piccolo needs time to gather the energy for the blast, which means Goku will have to last for five minutes against Raditz alone!

title: Gohan's Rage
summary: Goku Dies! There's Only One Chance LeftAs Goku takes blow after punishing blow from the evil Raditz, Gohan is able to watch no longer! The young boy's rage unlocks an awesome power sleeping within him, and he unleashes a mighty attack that not even Radtiz can resist! But as quickly as Gohan's power appears, it vanishes. And when Raditz prepares to strike back, Goku must make the ultimate sacrifice to save his son!

title: No Time Like the Present
summary: Even Enma-sama is Surprised — A Fight in the AfterlifeWith Raditz defeated and Goku gone from this world, the surviving Z-Fighters must begin preparing for the arrival of two more Saiyans who will reach Earth in one year's time. Piccolo takes Gohan into the wild for a severe training program, in the hope that his hidden power will be revealed. Meanwhile, Goku embarks on a new adventure in the next world, as he must travel the endless miles of Snake Way to receive training from the legendary King Kai!

title: Day 1
summary: Dinosaur Survival! Gohan's Difficult TrainingGohan begins his first day of Piccolo's training. Alone in the wilderness, he must quickly learn to take care of himself. But that isn't easy when he's tired, hungry -- and being chased by hungry dinosaurs! If Gohan's first day is this dangerous, how will he ever survive for the second?

title: Gohan Goes Bananas!
summary: The Great Transformation on a Moonlit Night! The Secret of Gohan's PowerKrillin receives a startling message. Korin wants him to gather Yamcha, Tien, and Chiaotzu and report for special training! And if that weren't enough, he and Roshi still have to find a way to tell Chichi what's happened to Goku and her son. Meanwhile, Gohan's training causes him to undergo a shocking transformation!

title: The Strangest Robot
summary: Sorry Robot-san — The Tears that Vanished in the DesertGohan falls into a hole in the desert and discovers a robot buried in sand in an ancient underground ruin. The robot tells him not to disturb its sleep, but Gohan, reluctantly, wakes it up again and again. As the robot looks after Gohan, it begins to get along with him.

title: A New Friend
summary: Don't Cry Gohan! His First FightKrillin visits Yamcha in preparation for the crisis one year from now. Yamcha, who had left martial arts to become a professional baseball player, decides to train under Kami after learning of Goku's death and the Saiyan invasion. Meanwhile, Gohan, who has been surviving in the wilderness, begins caring for an injured herbivorous dinosaur.

title: Terror on Arlia
summary: The Saiyan, Strongest Warriors in the Universe, Awaken!Vegeta and Nappa, two Saiyans heading to Earth, plan to plunder Planet Arlia on the way. However, the once fertile planet Arlia has become a ruined planet ruled by a dictator. The two are obediently taken to the castle, but Nappa wipes out the soldiers and easily defeats the ultimate monster weapon.

title: Global Training
summary: Catnap on the Serpent Road — Goku Takes a TumbleDespite being followed around by Lunch, Tenshinhan continues his training with Chiaotzu at a waterfall deep in the mountains. After hearing the story of Krillin and Bulma, he decides to undergo training from Kami. At the same time, Goku has finally made it halfway down the Snake Path.

title: Goz and Mez
summary: Hands Off! Enma-sama's Secret FruitTenshinhan and his friends start climbing the Karin Tower to undergo training from God. At the same time, Goku slips off Snake Way while sleeping and falls into Hell. Unable to return, Goku tries to eat the fruit of the Enshou Tree, but the demons Gozu and Mezu notice him. However, after hearing the story, they challenge Goku to a game of tag, on the condition that they show him the way out of Snake Way.

title: Princess Snake
summary: Such Sweet Temptation! The Snake Princess's HospitalityKrillin and the others begin their training at Kami's Lookout. Then, Goku returns to Snake Way and discovers a mansion along the way, where he is drawn in by a mysterious force. What's more, the owner of the mansion, the Snake Princess, falls in love with Goku at first sight. She uses various tactics to try and stop him, but Goku evades all of her temptations and tries to hurry on.

title: Dueling Piccolos
summary: Escape from Piccolo! Gohan Summons a StormWhen Goku had finally traveled halfway, Gohan, who was training in the wilderness, became homesick and tried to go back home. However, no matter how much he ran along the coast after passing through the desert, he always ended up back where he started. Curious, Gohan climbed a mountain and discovered that he was on an island.

title: Plight of the Children
summary: Run, Gohan! Longing for Mt. Paozu, Where Chi-Chi is WaitingGohan is caught in a storm and thrown into the sea, where he washes up on a shore where he is rescued by some unknown children. The group is orphans who have lost their parents and are living alone in the ruins, led by the eldest, Piguero. They refuse to be placed in an orphanage and have been on the run.

title: Pendulum Room Peril
summary: City of No Tomorrow! The Long Road to VictoryPiccolo and Gohan return to the wilderness and begin their training. After that, Krillin and the others, who are fed up with not receiving much training, are led to a room where all time is mixed together and are sent on a journey through time. Having traveled through time and space, the four are suddenly attacked by a mysterious duo.

title: The End of Snake Way
summary: Last Stop on Serpent Road! Are you Kaiō-sama?Six months have passed since the tail was cut off, and Gohan's tail has regenerated and he has once again transformed into a giant monkey! Piccolo immediately tries to destroy the moon, but no matter how much he attacks, he is unable to destroy it. Meanwhile, Goku has finally reached the end of the Snake Way.

title: Defying Gravity
summary: The Battle with Gravity! Catch Bubbles-kunGoku finally meets King Kai on King Kai's planet. He somehow manages to pass the gag test (?) set by King Kai, who loves puns, and finally begins his training on King Kai's planet. He chases King Kai's pet Bubbles for three weeks in gravity ten times that of Earth. After Goku successfully overcomes gravity and captures Bubbles, King Kai has certain expectations of him.

title: Goku's Ancestors
summary: The Return of the Saiyan Legend! Goku's RootsThe next training that King Kai assigns to Goku is to hit Gregory with a hammer. Gregory is faster than Bubbles, so Goku desperately pursues him! One day, King Kai tells Goku the history of the evil Saiyans and how they were wiped out, leaving only four of them.

title: Counting Down
summary: Come Forth, Shenlong! The Saiyans Finally Arrive on EarthGoku finishes his training on King Kai's planet and tests the power of the super technique, the Spirit Bomb, taught to him by King Kai. However, the Saiyans are approaching Earth sooner than expected. Furthermore, King Kai's miscalculation is discovered, and Goku is forced to return to the lower world in a hurry.

title: The Darkest Day
summary: Unbelievable!! Saibaimen, Born from the SoilThe Saiyans Vegeta and Nappa landed on Earth, searching for the one with the highest combat ability, and flew to where Piccolo and Gohan were.

title: Saibamen Attack!
summary: Yamcha Dies! The Terror of the SaibaimanKrillin, Piccolo, and Gohan stand face to face with the sinister Saiyans and their diabolical henchmen. The villains have already proven terrifyingly powerful. Can Earth's heroes hold out until Goku arrives?

title: The Power of Nappa
summary: Farewell, Ten-san! Chaozu's Suicide StrategyEnraged over the loss of Yamcha, Krillin unleashes a powerful attack that destroys the maniacal Saibamen once and for all. Now Earth's defenders must battle the Saiyans themselves - starting with Nappa.

title: Sacrifice
summary: Tenshinhan Cries Out!! This is My Last KikōhōChiaotzu sacrifices himself to save his friends from Nappa, but when the smoke clears, the villain still stands! Luckily, Tenshinhan has one trick left that could forever silence the Saiyan warrior!

title: Nappa's Rampage
summary: An Intense 3-Hour Delay! The Kinto-Un Bullet-ExpressVegeta has called a halt to the fighting, and Nappa uses the time to go on a rampage! Meanwhile, Goku reaches the end of Snake Way and races to re-join his friends - but is he already too late?

title: Nimbus Speed
summary: Leave it to Me! Gohan's Great Burst of AngerPiccolo, Gohan, and Krillin do their best to stop the Saiyans from finding the Dragon Balls. Meanwhile, Goku rushes back to Earth on the Flying Nimbus, armed with more power than ever before!

title: Goku's Arrival
summary: Ferocity of the Saiyans! God and Piccolo Both Die!Piccolo makes the ultimate sacrifice to save Gohan from the rampaging Saiyans. Just when all seems lost, Goku returns to Earth with an incredible new level of power and confronts the invaders.

title: Lesson Number One
summary: Father is Awesome! The Ultimate Finishing Technique: Kaiō-KenLocked in battle with the Saiyans, Goku gives Nappa a brutal demonstration of the training he received from King Kai. Broken and defeated, Nappa must now face the ferocious wrath of Vegeta!

title: Goku vs. Vegeta
summary: A Hot, Unbounded Battle! Goku vs VegetaGoku decides to take on mighty Vegeta all by himself! The two appear evenly matched, but both are hiding their true strength. The epic battle is underway - which mighty warrior will claim victory?

title: Saiyan Sized Secret
summary: Now, Goku! A Final Technique with Everything on the LineVegeta and Goku continue trading brutal blows, but the action intensifies when Vegeta reveals the secret power of the Saiyans: the ability to transform into a giant, planet-destroying ape!

title: Spirit Bomb Away!
summary: Battle Power Times 10!! Vegeta's Great TransformationGoku feels the brunt of Vegeta's fully-realised Saiyan power! Earth's greatest hero is left with no choice except to use the Spirit Bomb. If his attack fails, he may find himself completely doomed!

title: Hero in the Shadows
summary: Don't Die, Father!! This is Gohan's Hidden StrengthWith Goku caught in the clutches of the giant ape Vegeta, Krillin attacks with his Destructo Disk! When his effort falls short, an unlikely hero steps out of the shadows!

title: Krillin's Offensive
summary: Shoot, Kuririn! The Genki-Dama, Packed with HopeGoku passes the power of the Spirit Bomb to Krillin, who - with King Kai's guidance - launches the bomb at Vegeta. The Saiyan is sent flying into the sky, but is the evil warrior really gone for good?

title: Mercy
summary: Cause a Miracle! The Super Saiyan Son GohanVegeta is crushed beneath the full weight of Gohan's giant ape form! With the Saiyan battered and defeated, Krillin moves to finish the Saiyan with a final blow - but Goku has other plans.

title: Picking Up the Pieces
summary: We're Off Into Space! The Planet of Hope is Piccolo's HomelandThe gang mourns the loss of Yamcha, Tenshinhan, Chiaotzu, and Piccolo. With Kami gone, Earth's Dragon Balls have disappeared. Will the surviving heroes find a way to wish their fallen friends back to life?

title: Plans for Departure
summary: The Mysterious Yunzabit! The Search for Kami-sama's SpaceshipBulma accidentally destroys the Saiyan spaceship! Luckily, Mr. Popo reveals the existence of another ship that may be able to reach Namek. Can they find it in time, and will the old ship still work if they do?

title: Nursing Wounds
summary: Blast-off for Planet Namek! The Terror Awaiting Gohan and CompanyGoku, Krillin, and Gohan prepare for the return of the Saiyans. Meanwhile, Bulma and Mr. Popo search for a second spaceship capable of transporting her to Planet Namek.

title: Friends or Foes?
summary: Friends or Foes? Children of the Mysterious Giant SpaceshipGohan, Bulma, and Krillin blast off for Planet Namek in search of the magic Dragon Balls, but their journey quickly turns chaotic when they encounter a bizarre situation in the vacuum of space!

title: Held Captive
summary: Really, for Real? There Lies Namek, Planet of HopeBulma, Gohan, and Krillin are mistaken for friends of Frieza and taken prisoner by an angry army of children! To regain their freedom and continue on their mission, the gang must convince the kids of their innocence.

title: Look Out Below
summary: Kind-hearted Aliens — There's the Five-Star Ball AlreadyA near-fatal crash landing turns out to have a silver lining when Bulma, Gohan, and Krillin are rescued by two friendly Namekians who agree to help them locate the seven Dragon Balls.

title: The Search Continues
summary: Planet Freeza No. 79 — Vegeta Recovers!!Gohan, Krillin, and Bulma continue their search for the Dragon Balls with the help of their new friend Zarkro. Back on Earth, Goku has escaped from the hospital to begin training for his upcoming re-match with Vegeta.

title: A Friendly Surprise
summary: The Dragon Balls Are All Here! Piccolo-san Comes Back to LifeAs Bulma, Krillin, and Gohan close in on the last of the Dragon Balls, they uncover a shocking secret about their Namekian friends. Meanwhile, Goku works to build up his strength, and Vegeta sets his sights on revenge!

title: Brood of Evil
summary: A Tough New Enemy! Emperor of the Universe, FreezaBulma, Krillin, and Gohan finally continue their quest to locate all seven Dragon balls. Unfortunately, the gang soon discovers that they aren't the only ones seeking the magical balls.

title: Frieza Strikes!
summary: Vegeta's Ambition! I am the Greatest Warrior in the Universe!!Krillin, Gohan, and Bulma are horrified to see Vegeta's space pod land on Planet Namek, but the Saiyan Prince is the least of their problems. Yet another epically evil villain has come to Namek in search of the Dragon Balls!

title: Defying Orders
summary: Goku's Power at Full-Force!! Six Days to the End of the GalaxyWith the odds rapidly mounting against them, Krillin and Gohan will need some serious help if they hope to recover the Dragon Balls from Frieza and his henchmen.

title: Namek's Defense
summary: Surprise Attack!! The Elder's Target was the ScouterKrillin and Gohan get their first glimpse of Frieza's cruelty as the villain unleashes his henchmen upon an unsuspecting Namek village. Frieza wants the fifth Dragon Ball, and he is prepared to learn its location by any means necessary!

title: The Hunted
summary: Gohan in Peril! A Pursuing Dodoria Summons DeathGohan risks his life to rescue a Namek boy from the clutches of Frieza's evil henchmen. Now Gohan and Krillin have an even bigger problem on their hands: Dodoria is chasing them, and he won't stop until he has his revenge!

title: The Prince Fights Back
summary: Dodoria Dies by Explosion! Vegeta's Fearsome ShockwaveDodoria's search for Krillin and Gohan brings him face to face with an unexpected foe - Vegeta! The Saiyan prince has a score to settle with Dodoria, and the time for a final showdown between these two powerful villains has arrived!

title: Unexpected Problem
summary: Escape From a Burning Planet!! A Life-or-Death KamehamehaGoku's journey to Namek takes an unexpected detour when his spaceship is knocked off course by an asteroid! Goku has to act fast to get his ship back on track because he's headed straight for the fiery centre of a star!

title: Vegeta has a Ball
summary: Courage Times One Hundred! The Warriors Gather Under KaiōWith his new abilities, Vegeta quickly tracks down and forcefully acquires another Dragon Ball. Now, there is only one magic orb left to find, and Dende knows who has it - the Eldest Namekian!

title: The Past and the Future
summary: Listen to Me Goku! Hands Off FreezaKing Kai becomes concerned after learning that Goku is on a collision course with the ruthless Frieza. Meanwhile, back on Planet Namek, the battle between Vegeta and Zarbon has begun!

title: Zarbon's Special Surprise
summary: Nothing but Goosebumps! The Handsome Warrior Zarbon's Devilish TransformationVegeta's latest battle heats up as Zarbon reveals his true power: the ability to transform into a monstrous beast! With his increased size and strength, Zarbon seems ready to turn the lights out on the Saiyan Prince - permanently!

title: Guru's Gift
summary: Defend the Planet of Hope!! Kuririn's Astonishing Power-UpWhen Krillin speaks to the Eldest Namekian, he gets a double surprise! Not only does he receive a Dragon Ball, but the sleeping powers within him are awoken! Will Krillin's incredible new strength be enough to save his friends?

title: Piccolo vs. Everyone
summary: Back from the Brink of Death — The Miracle Man, VegetaOn Kaio's planet, Tenshinhan and the others continue their training against Bubbles and Gregory, but Piccolo, who has doubts about the results of his training, is the only one who does not participate. However, when they start sparring, Piccolo is surprised at how much Yamcha's skills have improved since before. Meanwhile, on Planet Namek, Vegeta has been treated from his injuries and has made a comeback.

title: Zarbon's Mission
summary: An Enormous Battle Power!! Freeza's Strategy is ShatteredVegeta steals the Dragon Ball from Freeza's spaceship and escapes! In an attempt to collect them all at once, he chases Krillin, who rushes to Bulma with the last one, but Zarbon, who notices the chase, appears and they are on the brink of an explosive confrontation. Meanwhile, Gohan takes advantage of Vegeta's distraction and gets the Dragon Ball that was sunk in the pond.

title: Gohan, the Hunted
summary: I'm Back to My Old Self Again!! Goku Takes on 100 Times GravityVegeta, who is after Krillin's Dragon Ball, and Zarbon, who has been chasing him, meet again. However, Vegeta easily defeats Zarbon after he transforms. Resigned to his strength, Krillin hands over the last Dragon Ball. At the same time, Goku inside the spaceship continues to fight against 100 times the gravity caused by a magnetic storm.

title: Unknown Enemies
summary: Freeza's Secret Weapon! The Devilish Ginyu Special SquadronThe Ginyu Special Forces launch from Planet Freeza! At their destination, Planet Namek, Gohan returns to Bulma with the Dragon Ball, but is discovered by Vegeta. However, Gohan quickly hides the Dragon Ball from Vegeta, and without a moment's rest, he rushes to the Elder's house with Krillin to have his potential unlocked.

title: Destination: Guru
summary: Bulma, Watch Out!! The Four-Star Ball Falls into Freeza's HandsFreeza unleashes a gigantic blast of energy that shakes the earth, causing Bulma's four-star ball to fall into the sea. Bulma hurriedly dives into the sea in a submarine and confronts a giant crab guarding the Dragon Ball and countless eggs. She manages to retrieve the Dragon Ball safely and return to the surface, but is then captured by Freeza's minions.

title: Bulma's Big Day
summary: Charge!! The Kaiō-Ken and Kamehameha of an Indomitable SpiritFreeza's subordinates hear Bulma's story and start plotting to get the Dragon Balls for themselves. Bulma tricks them into thinking there are still Dragon Balls remaining in the ocean and takes them on a tour of the ocean in a submarine, but her lie is exposed along the way! Meanwhile, inside the spaceship, Goku has overcome 100 times the gravity.

title: Hidden Power
summary: The Great Battle Approaches! The Ginyu Special Squadron Takes the Stage!!After successfully completing his training, Goku rests on the spaceship in preparation for the final battle on Planet Namek. Meanwhile, Krillin and Gohan finally arrive at the Elder's place, where they encounter Vegeta. They manage to draw out Gohan's power, but it is no match for Vegeta's. Then, five large powers approach Planet Namek.

title: New Ally, New Problem
summary: Goku on Final Approach! Smash through Freeza's DragnetThe Ginyu Force finally arrives on Planet Namek. The only way to defeat them is to make Vegeta immortal with the power of the Dragon Balls... Krillin and the others work with Vegeta to collect the Dragon Balls, but then the Ginyu Force appears.

title: Guldo's Mind Binds
summary: Is This Some Super-Magic or Just a Trick!? Mr. Gurd is Angry!The battle with the Ginyu Force begins, as Gohan and Krillin launch a barrage of explosive energy blasts at Guldo! The Heroes are rendered helpless by Guldo's Mind Blind technique, and this time, there is no one to save them!

title: Bardock: The Father of Goku
summary: Bardock, a low-level Saiyan soldier and his crew are on an assignment to slaughter the inhabitants of Planet Kanassa. They manage to accomplish this by using the planet's full moon to transform into Great Apes. The next morning, Bardock and his crew rest and celebrate their victory until one surviving Kanassan warrior catches him off-guard and decides to give him the "gift" of seeing the future as his way to avenge his people, before being killed by Bardock who subsequently passes out. Bardock returns to Planet Vegeta to heal and visits his infant son, Kakarot, who is being prepared to be sent to Earth in order to exterminate all life there.

title: Recoome Unleashed
summary: The Savage Reacoom! The Bad, Strong, and Outrageous GuyAfter defeating Guldo with a surprise attack, Vegeta faces off against Recoome. Vegeta launches a preemptive attack at full power, but even an attack with a battle power of 20,000 is ineffective against Recoome. Vegeta is left on the brink of death by the powerful attack. Just as he is about to be hit by Recoome's Eraser Gun, Krillin's quick thinking saves him.

title: Let the Battle Begin
summary: Don't Die, Gohan! Goku Finally Touches Down on the BattlefieldHaving collected all seven Dragon Balls, Freeza heads to the Elder to find out how to grant his wish. Meanwhile, Gohan attacks Recoome. He fights with all his might, but Recoome doesn't look too worried.

title: Goku's New Power
summary: Uncommon Strength!! The Legendary Super Saiyan, Son GokuFinally, Goku arrives. Understanding the entire situation, Goku gives Senzu Beans not only to Gohan and Krillin, but also to Vegeta. After making sure that the three are well, Goku goes up against Recoome by himself. Krillin and the others are worried that Goku is too calm, but Goku defeats Recoome with just one blow.

title: A Legend Revealed
summary: Lightning Balls of Red and Blue! Jheese and Butta Attack GokuJeice and Burter let their guard down when they see Goku's power level of 5,000 on their scouter, and begin their attack. However, even when the two of them launch direct attacks using their boastworthy speed, they are unable to land a single blow. Feeling that they are at a disadvantage in the hand-to-hand combat, the two finally activate their combined technique.

title: Ginyu Assault
summary: At Last, a Direct Confrontation!! Captain Ginyu Takes the FieldIn order to get Jeice and Burter to back off, Goku knocks Burter unconscious with one blow, showing the difference in their strength. Frightened by Goku's power, Jeice flies off to Commander Ginyu. Vegeta, infuriated that Jeice had escaped, finishes off Burter and Recoome, and berates Goku for being too soft on him. Meanwhile, Ginyu receives Jeice's report...

title: Incredible Force!
summary: Incredible Force!! Did You See It, Goku's Full Power?As the battle between Goku and Captain Ginyu rages on, Gohan and Krillin steal the unguarded Dragon Balls from Frieza's ship. It's a race against time, and our heroes must unlock the power of the Dragon Balls before it's too late!

title: Frieza Approaches
summary: What of the Battle's Outcome?! Freeza's Evil Hand Closes Around the EldestGoku astounds Captain Ginyu with his amazing new powers, but the Captain still has a few tricks up his sleeve! Meanwhile, Frieza arrives at the home of the Eldest Namek and begins a battle with the noble warrior, Nail!

title: Goku is Ginyu and Ginyu is Goku
summary: Surprise!! Goku is Ginyu and Ginyu is GokuIn an attempt to save the Elder, Nail fights a hopeless battle against the ruthless Frieza. Meanwhile, finding himself no match for Goku's superior abilities, Captain Ginyu unleashes his ultimate attack, the Body Switch Technique!

title: Calling the Eternal Dragon
summary: Come Forth, Super Shenlong!! Grant Me My WishArmed with the Dragon Radar, Gohan and Krillin recover the seven Dragon Balls from their hiding places. But before they can summon the Eternal Dragon to make their wish, they are confronted by a powerful new enemy - Goku?!

title: Gohan, Defeat Your Dad!!
summary: That Ain't Me! Gohan, Don't Lose Your Nerve, Hit Your Father!!After taking control of Goku's body, Captain Ginyu turns his attention to Gohan and Krillin! With Goku trapped in the Captain's broken body, it's up to Gohan to stop the rampaging Ginyu!

title: Captain Ginyu...The Frog
summary: A Huge Miscalculation!! Ginyu Has Turned into a FrogAs the bout between Captain Ginyu and Vegeta heats up, Goku summons the last of his strength and tricks his foe into reversing the Body Switch Technique. Now, Goku, Krillin, and Gohan must join forces with Vegeta for the battle with Frieza.

title: Piccolo the Super-Namek
summary: The Tide Suddenly Turns!! Piccolo, the Warrior Who Came LateVegeta witnesses Gohan's attack, but is unable to do anything due to the vast difference in strength. Just as Frieza is about to finish off Gohan, Krillin's Kienzan cuts Frieza's tail. Frieza is puzzled, and Krillin provokes him, running away. Dende takes advantage of the opportunity to rush over to Gohan. What power does Dende possess?

title: Déjà vu
summary: Piccolo's Self-Confidence! I Will Be the One to Defeat FreezaPiccolo quickly takes control of the battle with Frieza, and the putrid purple monster is shocked to learn the secret behind his opponent's powers!

title: Freeza's Second Transformation?
summary: Sally Forth, Goku!! A Furious Freeza's 2nd TransformationJust as it appears that Piccolo has gained the upper hand, Frieza quickly dashes all hopes for victory by revealing his second monstrous transformation!

title: Another Transformation?
summary: Fear Me!! Freeza Does Battle With a 3rd TransformationUnable to watch as Piccolo is overwhelmed by Frieza, Gohan springs into action! Meanwhile, Vegeta devises a risky plan.

title: Dende's Demise
summary: The Death of Dende... Come Forth! Intense, Full-Force PowerHaving reached his ultimate form, Frieza is determined to destroy the remaining Z-fighters one by one, but Vegeta boldly announces the end of Frieza's reign.

title: The Renewed Goku
summary: The Moment We've Waited For!!! Son Goku is RevivedVegeta, who firmly believes himself to be a Super Saiyan, fires off a full-power energy blast at Frieza, but it is easily deflected with a kick. He despairs at the overwhelming difference in power. Shedding tears, he experiences failure for the first time in his life... Vegeta has completely lost the will to fight, and just as death draws nearer, Goku's wounds finally heal.

title: The End of Vegeta
summary: Such Regret…!! The Proud Saiyan, Vegeta DiesGoku rejoins his friends on the battlefield, but not before Vegeta is defeated by Frieza!

title: The Ultimate Battle
summary: The Curtain Opens on the Super Decisive Battle!! I Am Going to Defeat YouGoku wages war on the monstrous Frieza! As the fight intensifies, Frieza directs his energy blasts at Namek itself, turning the planet into a lava-spewing warzone.

title: Clash of the Super Powers
summary: The Two Great Superpowers Collide! A Physical Battle Where Both Get Serious!!!Goku and Frieza continue their epic battle! An underwater attack puts Goku on top until Frieza traps him in an energy ball!

title: Freeza's Boast
summary: Freeza's Terrible Declaration! I Will Defeat You Without Using My HandsFrieza vows to beat Goku without using his hands.

title: Bold and Fearless
summary: That Ain't No Bluff!! The Audaciously Wonderful Guy, Son GokuCaptain Ginyu returns to the battlefield in Bulma's body!

title: Embodiment of Fire
summary: Showdown!! The Embodiment of Flame in a 20-Fold Kaiō-Ken KamehamehaGoku's powerful Kaio-Ken attack has no effect on Frieza.

title: Trump Card
summary: An Extra-Large Genki-Dama — This is the Final Trump Card!!Once again, Goku is rescued by a vision!

title: Keep the Chance Alive
summary: Seize the Chance!! Piccolo's Suicide Support StrikeYamcha, Tenshinhan, and Chiaotzu find themselves in serious trouble when the Ginyu Force invades King Kai's planet!

title: Power of the Spirit
summary: The Incredible Destructive Force of the Genki-Dama!! Who Will Survive?!Chaos erupts on King Kai's planet as the Z-fighters battle the Ginyu Force!

title: Transformed At Last
summary: Transformed At Last!! The Legendary Super Saiyan, Son GokuA victory celebration comes to a halt when Frieza reappears! With no reserves left, Goku watches helplessly as Frieza directs his fury at Piccolo and Krillin.

title: Explosion of Anger
summary: An Explosion of Anger!! Goku, Avenge Everyone's DeathsEngulfed in golden light, Goku announces that he is now a Super Saiyan.

title: Namek's Destruction
summary: The Destruction of Planet Namek?! A Demonic Flash Penetrates the GroundFinding himself no match for Goku, Frieza attacks Planet Namek! Unable to react in time, Goku is forced to watch helplessly as the fiery blast rips through the planet.

title: A Final Attack
summary: I Am Going To Win… Risking Survival, A Final AttackWith only minutes to go before the planet explodes, Frieza reaches his maximum power!

title: Approaching Destruction
summary: Shenlong, Fly Through Space!! The Time of Namek's Destruction Draws NearThe battle between Goku and Frieza rages on! Back on Earth, the seven Dragon Balls have been restored.

title: Gohan Returns
summary: I am Son Goku's Son!! Gohan Returns to the BattlefieldFrieza's victims have been wished back to life, but as they begin to rise, Goku falls - overwhelmed by Frieza's devastating assault.

title: The Last Wish
summary: I'm Staying on This Planet!! A Final Wish Toward VictoryThe Eldest and the people of Namek have been brought back to life, and the dragon Porunga has reappeared to grant the last of three wishes.

title: Duel On A Vanishing Planet
summary: Let's Get It On!! Two Remain on a Vanishing PlanetGoku chooses to stay behind and finish his fight with Frieza.

title: Pathos Of Frieza
summary: Pathos of Freeza! Once He Starts Shaking He's Unstoppable!!Time grows short for Goku as each passing second brings Namek closer to destruction.

title: Frieza Defeated!
summary: Goku's Declaration of Victory!! As Freeza Destroys Himself…Frieza lashes out in a blind rage, launching a reckless volley of energy attacks. In the face of Goku's superior power, the evil tyrant's greatest fear has come true.

title: Mighty Blast of Rage
summary: Freeza Defeated!! A Single Blast Packed With a Totality of RageLearning that the Namekian Dragon Balls can revive humans many times, Gohan and the others let out a cry of joy. Now they can bring Krillin and Chiaozu back to life. On Namek, Goku's crushing victory brings an end to the deadly battle. However, as Goku leaves, Freeza strikes the final blow...

title: Namek's Explosion... Goku's End?
summary: Planet Namek's Great Explosion!! Goku Disappears into SpaceEven though it looks like Goku is trapped on the exploding planet Namek, Dende has a good reason to celebrate: the Dragon Balls have the power to bring Goku back to life.

title: Goku's Alive!!
summary: Son Goku Survived — The Z Warriors Are All Resurrected!!It is a time of joyful reunions as old friends long absent are finally wished home with the Dragon Balls! Krillin and Yamcha are brought back from the spirit realm.

title: The Heavens Tremble
summary: Terrible Happenings in Heaven!! Garlic Jr. Becomes God?!Gohan's going fishing, Krillin's found a girlfriend, and it looks as though peace has once again returned to the Earth.

title: Black Fog of Terror
summary: Black Mist of Terror…!! Everyone Turns DemonicGarlic Junior releases the Black Water Mist upon an unsuspecting world. As the dreaded fog spreads, so does Garlic Junior's control over the Earth!

title: Battle in Kami's Lookout
summary: The Heavens Become the Battlefield!! Piccolo Becomes Devilish Again…As Piccolo attempts to hold off the Spice Boys and the infected Z Fighters, Gohan and Krillin race toward Kami's Lookout.

title: Call For Restoration
summary: Restore Everyone's Minds!! The Ultra Holy Water Resting in the TempleKrillin, after suffering a Spice Boys beating, attempts to free Kami and Mr. Popo, but he soon falls prey to the Black Water Mist.

title: Suicidal Course
summary: It Can't Wait Until Morning!! Kami-sama Decides on a Suicidal Course of ActionPiccolo and Krillin spring their trap, revealing that they have pretended to be infected by the Black Water Mist!

title: Extreme Measures
summary: A Battle of Extreme Measures!! Kami-sama Breaks the CovenantGarlic Junior and his Spice Boys harness the evil power of the Makyo Star to become stronger than ever, but Gohan, Krillin, and Piccolo are ready to battle.

title: The World Awakens
summary: The Ultra Holy Water Worked!! The World Awakens From its NightmareIn a last ditch effort to save his friends, Gohan launches an all out assault.

title: Brief Chance for Victory
summary: Gohan's Brief Chance for Victory!! Destroy Planet Makyō…Blinded by rage and desperate to destroy his enemies, Garlic Junior uses his power to open up the Dead Zone!

title: Krillin's Proposal
summary: You're My Guy… Kuririn — The 101st ProposalKrillin faces his toughest challenge ever: surviving a shopping trip with Maron! And it looks like she's picking out a wedding dress!

title: Frieza's Counterattack
summary: That's Earth, Papa… Freeza and his Father Strike BackGohan's cracking the books, and his new tutor is cracking the whip!

title: The Mysterious Youth
summary: I Will Defeat Freeza… The Mysterious Boy Awaiting GokuThe Earth faces its darkest hour as Frieza and his father King Cold rapidly approach!

title: Another Super Saiyan?
summary: Freeza Halved By a Single Blow!! Another Super SaiyanFrieza and King Cold descend upon the Earth, but a mysterious warrior has come to thwart their diabolical plot for revenge.

title: Welcome Back Goku
summary: Heya!! It's Been a While… Son Goku ReturnsAfter defeating Frieza and King Cold, the mysterious stranger announces the exact time and place of Goku's arrival on Earth.

title: Mystery Revealed
summary: My Dad is Vegeta… Confessions of the Mysterious BoyAfter testing Goku in combat, the mysterious stranger reveals his true identity!

title: Goku's Special Technique
summary: Goku's New Finishing Technique?! Watch This, My Instantaneous MovementThe future has been written - or has it? That's what Goku and the rest of the Z-Fighters must decide as they hear Trunks' ominous warning.

title: Z Warriors Prepare
summary: I Will Overcome… Goku!! The King of the Saiyan Warrior RaceGohan learns some new tricks, Vegeta pushes himself to the breaking point, and Yamcha struggles just to keep up.

title: Goku's Ordeal
summary: License Mastery? Goku's Newest TrialGoku and Piccolo take a day off from training to enroll in driving school. These two mighty warriors may be the Earth's only chance for survival.

title: The Androids Appear
summary: Murderers Who Leave No Trace — Which Ones Are the Artificial Humans?!The Androids are here, and they're wreaking havoc on an unsuspecting city! Goku and his friends must now put their training to the test!

title: A Handy Trick
summary: The Cold-Blooded No. 20's Hideous Atrocities!! Goku's Super Transformation of AngerYamcha is held at the mercy of the ruthless No. 20, and Goku and the others must race to help their friend.

title: Double Trouble for Goku
summary: Goku's Double-Shock!! Caught Between Illness and AdversaryThe battle with the Androids begins as Goku launches an all out assault against #19. The Super Saiyan seems to have the fight under control.

title: Upgrade to Super Saiyan
summary: The Might of Vegeta!! The Blood of a Super Saiyan AwakensAttacked from within by a crippling virus, Goku is helpless against the maniacal #19. But just when it looks like the end for Goku, Vegeta appears on on the scene.

title: The Secret of Doctor Gero
summary: No. 20's Defiant Smile… The Secret of Doctor GeroIn his first fight as a Super Saiyan, Vegeta takes control of the battlefield.

title: More Androids?!
summary: A Present More Terrifying Than the Future?! Trunks' SuspicionsVegeta, Piccolo, and Gohan lead an exhaustive search through the mountains for #20. But the hunters are also the hunted!

title: Seized with Fear
summary: Trunks and Krillin join Bulma at the crash site of the mysterious time capsule and find an eerie clue: the shell of a large, locust-like creature! Whatever arrived in the time capsule isn't human, and it's on the loose!

title: The Reunion
summary: An insect-like monster threatens to turn Gingertown into a ghastly graveyard! In response to this new menace, Kami fuses with Piccolo, and the resulting Super Namekian flies to Gingertown for a showdown of epic proportions!

title: Borrowed Powers
summary: Gingertown becomes a battlefield as Piccolo confronts Cell. This monster from the future gains his strength by sucking the life out of his victims! But that's not the creature's only talent. He also knows the Kamehameha Wave!

title: His Name Is Cell
summary: A Life Form of Evil and Destruction!! His Name is Artificial Human CellHeavily-armored tanks fail to halt Cell's rampage, and now it's up to Piccolo to stop the monster! As the Namekian fights for survival, Cell reveals that he's actually an android, the ultimate achievement of Dr. Gero!

title: Piccolo's Folly
summary: Piccolo's Grievous Mistake! Cell Escapes Into the City!Piccolo cleverly distracts Cell long enough to regenerate his arm. The Namekian is ready for another round, and Krillin and Trunks have arrived to provide backup! With the odds mounting against him, Cell makes a tactical decision.

title: Laboratory Basement
summary: The Secret of Cell's Birth! What Lies Below the Laboratory?!With hopes of saving the future, Trunks and Krillin race to destroy Dr. Gero's lab. Meanwhile, Piccolo and Tien search for the elusive Cell. But how can they stop an enemy who knows their every move?

title: Our Hero Awakes
summary: Goku Awakens to Battle! Go Beyond the Super Saiyan!!In South City, Cell plows through more civilians and accidentally runs into Krillin! Goku finally gets back on his feet, but with Cell and the other androids in full stride, can the Saiyan hero still make a difference?

title: Time Chamber
summary: Hasten Your Training, Saiyans! In the Room of Spirit and Time…As Cell continues his deadly march, Goku hatches a plan to squeeze a year's worth of training into just one day! Back at Master Roshi's, the android trio arrives looking for Goku! Can Piccolo hold them off until the Saiyans return?

title: The Monster is Coming
summary: The Gekiretsu Kodan that Split the Heavens!! Piccolo vs Artificial Human No. 17Behind the closed doors of the Hyperbolic Time Chamber, Vegeta and Trunks struggle to push past the level of Super Saiyan! Down on Earth, Piccolo challenges Android 17 to a battle!

title: He's Here
summary: How I Have Waited For this Day!! Cell's Prologue to PerfectionStronger than ever after fusing with Kami, Piccolo leads the attack against the androids! It looks like the Super Namekian has things under control until Cell arrives on the battlefield! Can anyone stop this hideous monster?!

title: Up to Piccolo
summary: The Suicidal Counterattack Proves Ineffective! Piccolo's Flame Burns Out!!Just as Cell is about to absorb Android 17, Piccolo bravely steps in and foils the monster's plan! Does the Super Namekian really have a chance at stopping Cell on his own?! Or is he simply putting off the inevitable?

title: Silent Warrior
summary: One Final Remaining Hope… The Silent Warrior No. 16 Takes Action!!When Android 16 claims to be as strong as Cell, it seems like a wild boast! But after he launches an offensive that throws Cell against the ropes, it becomes clear that the big android has the power to back up his words!

title: Say Goodbye, 17
summary: No. 17 is Swallowed… The Transforming Cell is a Super GourmetIt's android against android as 16 clashes with Cell. Android 16 is the stronger fighter, but Cell is far too driven to be stopped now! With an underheanded attack, Cell moves one step closer to his gruesome transformation!

title: Sacrifice
summary: Tomorrow I am Going to Pulverize You!! Goku's ChallengeWith an onslaught of psychic blasts, Tien gives Androids 16 and 18 a chance to escape, but the powerful attack rapidly drains his strength. Tien may have saved the androids, but can he save himself?

title: Saiyans Emerge
summary: I'll Finish Everything!! A Reborn Vegeta, Father and Son, Sally ForthTrunks and Vegeta emerge from the time chamber after a year of intense training. Goku and Gohan are next into the room, but with Cell nearing his ultimate form, can the fighters afford to wait another day?

title: Super Vegeta
summary: Suddenly Full-Throttle!! The Radiant Vegeta's Super PowerCell obliterates a chain of islands in search of Android 18! Vegeta, fresh from the time chamber, is ready to test his new strength against the monster, but is he really stronger than a Super Saiyan?

title: Bow to the Prince
summary: On Your Knees, Cell! I am Super Vegeta!!Vegeta shows cell his new power while Goku and Gohun train.

title: The Last Defense
summary: A Shock to the Entire Universe!! Cell, A Spectacular Evolution Toward His Perfect FormWith the remote control smashed, Krillin and Trunks must save Android 18 from Cell's power-hungry grasp. But Vegeta has other plans in mind. Will trunks attack his own father to save humanity?

title: Cell is Complete
summary: An Infinite Battle Power!! The Birth of the God of Destruction is Named CellThe earth's greatest fear has come true: Cell is complete! Can anyone stop the android nightmare in his final, perfect form? As the heroes nervously line up, a glimmer of hope shines from above. Gohan is a Super Saiyan!

title: Vegeta Must Pay
summary: Super Vegeta in Peril!! An Absolutely Perfect Terror Closes In!!After allowing Cell to reach his final form, Vegeta is ready for the challenge he was promised. But as Cell easily deflects the Saiyan's every blow, it's clear that Vegeta has more his hands than he bargained for!

title: Trunks Ascends
summary: Breaking Through the Boundaries of the Super Saiyan!! Trunks Summons a StormTapping into the deepest wells of his energy, Vegeta summons one last attack: the Final Flash! Meanwhile, Trunks struggles to decide whether or not to help his father. Vegeta's pride is at stake, but so is his life!

title: Saving Throw
summary: Save Your Father!! Trunks' Fury, Which Scorches Even the HeavensVegeta lies unconscious after his battle with Cell, and Trunks unleashes his hidden powers to save his father's life. With Goku and Gohan still training, Trunks is the only person standing in the evil android's way.

title: Ghosts from Tomorrow
summary: A Future of Despair!! Trunks, the Man Who Lived Through HellTrunks vows to stop the future from repeating itself; Cell can't wait for the future to unfold. It's all up for grabs as the two warriors prepare for battle. Only one future will survive. Whose will it be?

title: The Cell Games
summary: Super Trunks Has a Weakness!! Cell, A Shocking Bombshell DeclarationRealizing that his powers are no match for his opponent, Trunks accepts defeat, only to be given a second chance when Cell proposes a tournament! Is Cell really interested in competition, or does he have a sinister motive?

title: Dende's Dragon
summary: Dende's New Occupation!! The Dragon Balls are RevivedWith help from King Kai, Goku travels to Namek to recruit a new guardian for the Earth! Most of the Namekians refuse the offer, but there's one little guy who can't wait to go! Dende is back, and he's going to create a new Dragon!

title: The Puzzle of General Tao
summary: Goku's Perplexing Problem?! The Dragon Balls are Taken BackGoku comes face to face with an old adversary: General Tao! The search for the Dragon Balls led Goku to the aging general, but unless the Super Saiyan can solve the crafty villain's puzzle, the search may end in vain!

title: The Games Begin
summary: Cell's Standing Challenge!! The Opening to the Decisive BattleThe wait is over, and the Cell Games are ready to begin! The Z-Fighters arrive ringside, only to discover another challenger already on the scene. It's none other than World Martial Arts Champion, Mr. Satan!

title: The History of Trunks
summary: In an alternate timeline, two years after defeating Frieza and King Cold, Goku succumbs to a viral heart disease. Goku's death, being the result of natural causes, means that he can no longer be revived with the Dragon Balls. Six months later, Piccolo, Vegeta, Krillin, Tien Shinhan, Yamcha, and Chiaotzu are killed by Android 17 and Android 18. With the death of Piccolo, Earth's guardian, Kami, dies as well and the Dragon Balls are rendered permanently useless - making it impossible for anyone to be revived.

title: Losers Fight First
summary: Wait Just a Minute!! The Great Satan Army ArrivesCaroni and Pirozhki, Mr. Satan's top students, make a spectacular entrance to the ring, but are they really ready to rumble with Cell? Don't miss a minute of the fun, because this fight could be over fast!

title: Goku vs. Cell
summary: Goku's Bout!! The Super-Tense Cell GamesGoku and Cell start fighting with each other in the ring. If Cell wins then he'll destroy the earth. If Goku wins then the Cell will give up.

title: Cell's Bag of Tricks
summary: A Direct Hit to the Earth!! Cell's Huge KamehamehaCell attacks Goku with a dazzling array of moves including the Destructo Disk, the Special Beam Cannon, and even the Kamehameha Wave! Goku matches the monster blow for blow, but how long can he last against such a lethal arsenal?

title: No More Rules
summary: Lose or Die?! Goku, A Secret Turnabout PlanAs the battle intensifies, Cell quickly grows tired of the rules he created for the tournament. With a flick of his finger, the Android destroys the ring, instantly turning the Cell Games into a deadly fight to the finish!

title: The Fight is Over
summary: The End of the Desperate Struggle!! Goku Surrenders?!Goku blasts Cell with a Kamehameha Wave that reduces the android to a pile of cinders, but his triumph is short-lived. The monster shows his amazing resilience by fully regenerating himself!

title: Faith in a Boy
summary: Someone Who Will Succeed the Strongest… His Name is GohanAfter surrendering to Cell, Goku names the next challenger to enter the Cell Games: Gohan! Goku has supreme faith in his son's abilities, but the young Saiyan will need a lot more than his father's confidence if he's going to survive!

title: Gohan's Plea
summary: Get Angry, Gohan—Release the Dormant Power WithinThe fight between Gohan and Cell intensifies, but the villain's attacks seem to have no effect on the boy! Could the young hero really have the power to defeat the evil android once and for all?

title: Android Explosion
summary: Miniature Threats!! The Cell Juniors AttackCell is determined to unleash Gohan's full potential, but the boy refuses to fight, prompting the android to torture Gohan's friends instead! Next, Cell does the unthinkable by spawning miniature Cells to attack the Z-Fighters!

title: Cell Juniors Attack!
summary: The Tragedy of No. 16!! Super Gohan's Anger ExplodesGohan boils with rage as the Cell Juniors wreak havoc on the Z-Fighters. The boy struggles to resist the urge to fight, but he's a powder keg waiting to explode, and Android 16 appears ready to light the fuse!

title: Awakening
summary: Anger Exploding Into Power!! The Cell Juniors are Destroyed"The Unleashing" - After Android 16 tells Gohan to unleash his powers. Gohan becomes super sayan and starts destroying cells children.

title: The Unstoppable Gohan
summary: Cell is Knocked Out!! Taken Down With Two Super PunchesCell's desire for battle turns into a nightmare as Gohan unleashes the full fury of his strength. The evil android powers up to his maximum level, but will it be enough to spare him from the wrath of Super Saiyan?

title: Cell's Break Down
summary: Cell's Disaster!! The Destruction of His Perfect FormGohan's Super Saiyan strength appears to have no limit, and the young hero delivers a blow so severe it causes Cell to cough up Android 18!

title: A Hero's Farewell
summary: Bye-Bye Everyone!! Goku's Last Instant MovementClearly overmatched by Gohan, Cell initiates his last line of defense: a self-destruct program that will blow up the entire planet! With only seconds to spare, Goku risks everything to transport Cell away from the Earth.

title: Cell Returns!
summary: The Nightmare is Reborn!! An Absolute and Perfect TerrorThe nightmare continues! Cell explodes, but a particle of his nucleus survives the blast, providing all the android needs to regenerate himself! Restored to his ultimate form, Cell returns to the Earth more powerful than ever!

title: The Horror Won't End
summary: From Goku to Gohan… A Father's Spirit is Passed DownVegeta lashed out against Cell but was incapacitated in a single blow. Gohan jumps in front to save Vegeta and is wounded in the process. Cell and Gohan unleash their devastating Kamehameha waves as they collide in a fierce beam struggle.

title: Save the World
summary: The Fight is Over… Thank You, Son GokuThe final showdown begins! While Goku telepathically coaches Gohan from the Other World, the Z-Fighters jump in for a five-sided attack! Gohan has the potential inside him, but can Goku show him how to unlock it?

title: Goku's Decision
summary: I Will Carry On in the Afterlife!! Farewell with a SmileCell is finally defeated, but the Z-Fighters still have much to resolve! Can they make it to the Lookout in time to heal the badly-injured Gohan? Is Android 18 still a threat? And can our heroes find a way to bring back Goku?

title: One More Wish
summary: A New Day Will Come… Father! I'll Hang in ThereWith one more wish left, what shall the Z-Fighters wish for?

title: Free the Future
summary: Peace and order have been restored on Earth in the present, but Trunks' future world is still a place of darkness and despair! Once he arrives home, the future will be forever changed!

title: Warriors of the Dead
summary: When Goku hears about a martial arts master known as the Grand Kai, he rushes to meet him for a lesson! Meanwhile, Cell, Frieza, King Cold and the Ginyu Force have teamed up to take control of Other World!

title: Tournament Begins
summary: Goku must train for 10,000 years before he can study under the Grand Kai! But when the West, South, and East Kaiâ€ôs decide to hold an Other World Tournament, Goku gets his chance! All he has to do is defeat the greatest fighters of all time!

title: Water Fight
summary: The Other World Tournament advances to the Quarter-Finals, and the battles are out of this world! Goku's opponent, Arqua, appears to be a wimp, but things change quickly when he transforms the entire ring into water!

title: Final Round
summary: Goku advances to the final round of the tournament where he will face the warrior Pikkon! Sparks of energy fly as the brawlers battle for the title! When Pikkon reveals a Piccolo-like secret, Goku must up the ante! It's Super Saiyan time!

title: Goku vs.Pikkon
summary: Goku may be a Super Saiyan, but can he withstand Pikkon's unbelievable Thunder Flash Attack?! And that's not all! While Goku's been fighting in Other World, seven years have passed on Earth, Gohan is now a teenager!

title: Gohan Goes to High School
summary: 7 Years Since That Event! Starting Today, I'm a High SchoolerOn his first day of high school, Gohan stops a truckload of bank robbers by turning Super Saiyan. Now, the city can't stop talking about this mysterious "Gold Fighter!" Can Gohan get through class without revealing his secret identity?

title: I am Saiyaman!
summary: The Champion and Lover of Justice — The Great Saiyaman AppearsAfraid he will be recognized by his classmates, Gohan gets Bulma to design a retractable super-hero costume that he can activate in an instant. Say goodbye to Gohan - and hello to Saiyaman.

title: Gohan's First Date
summary: Gohan's Confusing First Date?!Gohan thinks being a super-hero is a snap until a pretty girl named Angela discovers his secret. When Angela threatens to tell all unless he goes on a date with her, Gohan's life suddenly becomes more complicated than ever!

title: Rescue Videl
summary: Gohan, Get Moving Quick! Rescue Videl!!When the Red Shark Gang kidnaps the mayor and demands a showdown with Mr. Satan, it's Videl who answers the challenge. Gohan knows Videl is in over her head, but he can't leave his classroom to help her without blowing his cover!

title: Blackmail
summary: A Robbery Case!! The Culprit is Saiyaman?!When a greedy circus promoter kidnaps a baby dinosaur, all he sees are dollar signs! Little does he know, that the dinosaur is a close, personal friend of the Great Saiyaman!

title: I'll Fight Too
summary: Goku's Also Resurrected?! He's Participating in the Tenka'ichi Budōkai!!The Great Saiyaman is about to become a movie star but the hero's brush with stardom better not take long, because he has to hurry up and tell all of his old friends the big news: Goku is coming back.

title: The Newest Super Saiyan
summary: Even Gohan is Surprised! Goten's Explosion of PowerWhile training for the upcoming tournament, Gohan discovers that Goten has already reached the level of Super Saiyan! Sparks fly when the brothers spar, but the main event happens when Videl meets Chichi for the first time!

title: Take Flight, Videl
summary: Ah, I Flew!! Videl's Introduction to FlightWith the Tournament fast approaching, Videl and Goten must learn to fly! Miles away, Vegeta holds a training session of his own, and his young son, Trunks, has a big surprise in store for him

title: Gather for the Tournament
summary: Welcome Back, Goku! The Whole Z Team Assembles!!Videl learns to fly, and Gohan and Goten do some last minute honing of their Super Saiyan skills. On the island where the tournament will be held, a special guest arrives! What do you say to a hero who's been dead for seven years?!

title: Camera Shy
summary: You're in Danger, Saiyaman! Guard Yourself Against a Perfectly Timed Photo?!Everyone qualifies for the World Tournament.

title: The World Tournament
summary: No Small Matter!! Little TrunksThe action begins as the World Martial Arts Tournament opens with the Junior Division! Thirty-five young fighters vie for the prize, but the matches prove to be more comedy than competition - until Trunks steps into the ring!

title: Trunks vs. Goten
summary: It's My Turn!! Goten's Anxious First FightGoten and Trunks breeze through the Junior Division of the tournament until they find themselves going head-to-head in the finals! Who will win this exciting match? This is one championship fight you won't want to miss!

title: Best of the Boys
summary: Happiness Times a Million! The Junior Champion is Decided!!The match for the Junior Division World Championship continues as Goten and Trunks battle for the title! The winner of this final joust becomes the new World Champion! Can Goten outwit the cunning Trunks?

title: Big Trouble, Little Trunks
summary: Now What, Satan?! The Greatest Pinch in HistoryAfter winning the championship, Trunks fights an exhibition match against Mr. Satan! Can the Champ hold on to his reputation as the world's strongest fighter? Meanwhile, two mysterious figures reveal themselves to Goku!

title: Who Will Fight Who?
summary: The Match-Ups Are Decided!! Hurry and Hold the First RoundTrunks and Gohan infiltrate the adult competition at the tournament by donning the disguise of Mighty Mask. The pairings for the day matches are selected. The first to fight: Krillin vs. Pintar, a man easily ten times Krillins size!

title: Forfeit of Piccolo
summary: What's the Matter, Piccolo?! An Unheard-of No-Fight ForfeitPiccolo stuns the crowd by surrendering to his mysterious opponent before the first punch is thrown! Next into the ring is Videl, who must face the enormous Spopovitch. Will she be able to handle such a large job?

title: A Dark and Secret Power
summary: Undyingly Unpleasant?! The Mystery of SpopovitchVidel takes to the ring for what is expected to be an easy victory over Spopovitch. She hits the towering brute with everything shes got, but her attacks have no effect. It seems Spopovitch is possessed by a supernatural power!

title: Videl is Crushed
summary: A Tragic Videl!! Are You Coming Out, Angry Super Gohan?To everyones horror, Spopovitch delays his inevitable victory for the purposes of torturing Videl! It appears the muscle-bound thug isn't going to stop until he kills her! Will Videl make it out of the ring alive?

title: Identities Revealed
summary: Exposed!! The Saiyaman is Son GohanGohan's identity is finally discovered as he takes his place on the tournament floor, but he has bigger things to worry about. His opponent, Kibito, is determined to see him transform into a Super Saiyan!

title: Energy Drain
summary: A Slithering Conspiracy!! Gohan's Power is StolenWhen Gohan transforms into a Super Saiyan, Spopovitch and Yamu spring into action! Armed with a mysterious energy-draining device, the pair launch an attack on the golden-haired teen.

title: The Wizard's Curse
summary: The Man Behind the Curtain Appears!! The Evil Mage BabidiThe Z-Fighters race to stop Babidi's cronies from delivering the pure energy that will be used resurrect the dreaded Majin Buu. Will they find Babidis hidden spaceship in time?

title: King of the Demons
summary: The Awaiting Trap!! A Challenge From the Demon RealmPiccolo and Krillin are turned to stone by Dabura! Determined to save their friends, Goku, Gohan, and Vegeta board Babidi's ship only to find themselves trapped! Can they save their friends and find their way out?

title: Vegeta Attacks
summary: Don't Toy With Me!! Vegeta Breaks Through the First Fight in a FuryAt each stage of Babidi's ship, Goku, Gohan, and Vegeta must face a fearsome warrior, each more powerful than the last. There's no room for error. Even the tiniest mistake will enable Babidi to steal their energy for Majin Buu.

title: Next Up, Goku
summary: Goku's Power Wide Open!! Blow Away YakonBabidi unleashes his monster Yakon to steal the Z-Fighters' energy for Majin Buu. The battle at Stage Two is sure to be intense, as Yakon is one of the most fearsome creatures in the universe!

title: Battle Supreme
summary: A Great Miscalculation!! Satan vs Three Super Warriors?!At the World Martial Arts Tournament, the five remaining competitors enter the ring for an all-out Battle Royale! The fists fly as Number 18, Mighty Mask, and Mr. Satan duke it out to decide who will be the next Champion of the World!

title: Eighteen Unmasks
summary: Such Strong Kids!! No. 18's Close Fight?!The battle heats up as Number 18 and Mighty Mask take their fight to the skies. Number 18 gives it everything she's got, but her attacks prove useless against her masked opponent. Could she find the edge she needs to win?

title: Pay to Win
summary: A Confrontation With the Demon King! It's Your Turn Gohan!!As the final bout of the tournament continues, Number 18 throws the defending champ for a loop by offering to throw the fight! Meanwhile, Babidi has selected his warrior for Stage 3: Dabura, King of the Demon World!

title: Heart of a Villain
summary: A Wicked Heart is Discovered!! Dabura's Good IdeaThe intense battle between Gohan and Dabura rages on, but just as the Stage 3 clash reaches a heated peak, Dabura stops the fight! Why has the evil giant conceded, and what is the great discovery he claims to have made?

title: The Dark Prince Returns
summary: Vegeta, the Prince of Destruction, is Revived!! Intrusion at the TournamentIn an all-out assault against Vegeta, Babidi uses his power to undo the unsuspecting Prince from within! Vegeta is stripped of his good qualities by the wicked wizard, and becomes the heartless warrior that he once was!

title: Vegeta's Pride
summary: A Super Confrontation of Destiny!! The Clash of Goku vs VegetaGoku has no choice but to accept Vegeta's challenge.

title: The Long Awaited Fight
summary: Just You Wait, Babidi!! Your Aspirations Will Not be AllowedThe battle between Goku and Vegeta has begun! With Babidi's magic enhancing his already incredible strength, Vegeta matches Goku move for move, but every blow the Saiyan Prince lands is a boost for Majin Buu!

title: Magic Ball of Buu
summary: The Seal is Broken! Out Comes the Vicious Majin Buu!!Gohan and the Supreme Kai confront Babidi in the depths of his space ship. With the fight between Goku and Vegeta supplying vast quantities of energy for Majin Buu, with not a moment to lose.

title: Buu is Hatched
summary: I Won't Allow the Revival!! A Kamehameha of ResistanceThe seal encasing Buu is finally broken! Supreme Kai insists on retreat, but Gohan refuses, launching an incredible series of energy attacks. When the shell opens, nothing is inside! Gohan, however, there is no time to celebrate..

title: The Losses Begin
summary: A Straight Line to Despair?! The Grief of KaiōshinWith his big pink belly and infantile behavior, Buu doesn't fit the bill of a galaxy destroyer - until he hurls Dabura into a cliff with a single blow! Gohan senses a limitless power, and the Supreme Kai insists this is the end!

title: The Terror of Majin Buu
summary: Supreme Kai must use his unique fighting powers to keep Buu at bay - or lose his life! One mile away, Goten and Trunks stumble upon Piccolo, still frozen in stone, and accidentally shatter him to pieces! And there's more! The King of Demons returns!

title: Meal Time
summary: Free from the grip of Babidi, Vegeta decides to seek his revenge by destroying the monster Majin Buu. Assuming Gohan to be a victim of the voracious villain, the Super Saiyan goes ballistic. Can Vegeta bring down Buu?

title: The Warrior's Decision
summary: A Warrior's Resolution!! I Will Dispose of the MajinThe battle between Prince of Destruction Vegeta and Buu has begun! Vegeta is forced into a tough fight like never before as Buu shows no signs of taking any damage even after a hole is pierced in his stomach. Just as Vegeta is in a pinch due to Buu's unconventional strategy of wrapping his own torn body around his opponent and attacking him, Trunks steps in, unable to bear the sight!

title: Final Atonement
summary: For Those Whom He Loves… Vegeta Perishes!!After fighting with Majin Buu, Vegeta realizes he isn't fighting for just himself, but for the entire planet, and commits the ultimate sacrifice.

title: Evil Lives On
summary: The Nightmare Revisited! Majin Buu has SurvivedMajin Buu's flesh is scattered on the battlefield, but his mystical power is rebuilding the monster into one deadly piece. Babidi is recovering, too, having narrowly survived Piccolo's attack.

title: Find the Dragonballs
summary: The Struggle of Videl and the Others! Find the Dragon BallsVidel, Yamcha, Master Roshi, Chi Chi and Bulma find the last Dragon Ball... then it gets eaten by a dinosaur.

title: Revival
summary: Enormous Hope!! A New Finishing Technique for the Little SquirtsGoku hatches a plan for defeating Majin Buu: Fusion! By joining two fighters of equal size and strength, an entirely new fighter can be created. But only one such pair remains-Goten and Trunks! Can the young half-Saiyans save the world?

title: Global Announcement
summary: Goten and Trunks — The World's Most WantedBabidi seeks vengeance against Piccolo, Goten, and Trunks! Plastering images on everyone's mind, Babidi threatens to terrorize humanity until the trio is brought forward! Meanwhile, Gohan is taken to Supreme Kai's world!

title: Learn to Fuse!
summary: Gohan is Revived — Kaiōshin's Secret Weapon?!Goku begins training Goten and Trunks in the art of Fusion. Meanwhile, Gohan, having been healed in Supreme Kai's world, tries to remove the legendary Z-Sword to use in the fight against Majin Buu!

title: The Z Sword
summary: It Came Ou~t!! The Legendary Z SwordMajin Buu launches into a feeding frenzy, transforming an entire town's population into chocolate! Gohan draws the ancient Z-Sword, Goku struggles to teach Goten and Trunks the art of Fusion, and an unlikely hero is asked to join the fight!

title: Race to Capsule Corp.
summary: West City is Targeted! Stop, Majin Buu!!As Goten and Trunks train to stop the vicious Majin Buu, Idasa's jaded mother tells Babidi exactly where Trunks lives! The Z-Fighters must now find a way to stop the evil wizard before he reaches Capsule Corp!

title: Super Saiyan 3
summary: An Astounding, Great Transformation!! Super Saiyan 3Trunks searches frantically for the lost dragon radar, and Goku powers-up to an unimaginable level: Super Saiyan 3! Will this newfound strength be enough to stop Majin Buu from destroying West City?

title: Buu's Mutiny
summary: Bye-Bye, Babidi!! Majin Buu RebelsGoku uses his new Super Saiyan 3 abilities to combat the evil Majin Buu, buying Trunks the time he needs to locate the missing Dragon Radar. But now that Goku has started the fight, he may not be able to escape!

title: The Fusion Dance
summary: Absurdly Awful Looking?! The Special Training Transformation PoseLiberated from his master, Majin Buu becomes even more destructive than before, wiping out entire cities in mere seconds! Earth's only hope now rests on the shoulders of two young warriors: Goten and Trunks!

title: Goku's Time Is Up
summary: See You Later, Everybody!! Goku Returns to the AfterlifeTensions rise for Goten and Trunks as their duel with Majin Buu approaches. Meanwhile, Buu prepares for the upcoming battle by building himself a home! Elsewhere, Goku bids a poignant farewell as he finally returns to Other World.

title: Return to Other World
summary: Where is Gohan?! Training in the Kaiōshin RealmWhile Trunks and Goten continue their quest to perfect the Fusion Technique, Gohan seeks to master the Z-Sword. Back on Earth, an encounter with a blind boy reveals that there is another side to the belligerent Buu!

title: Out from the Broken Sword
summary: You're Kidding, Right?! The Z Sword is BrokenGohan breaks the Z Sword in training, but from within it comes a new Kai, with a new technique!

title: Gotenks is Born
summary: The Birth of a Superhuman Warrior!! His Name is GotenksAfter many comical misfires, Trunks and Goten finally perfect the Fusion technique, and Gotenks is born! Defying Piccolo's command, the super-kid immediately leaves to go fight Majin Buu! Is Gotenks ready for the fight of his young life?

title: Unlikely Friendship
summary: The Final Weapon is Engaged?! Satan Will Save the EarthAs Majin Buu continues to terrorize humanity, a lone savior appears: Mr. Satan! But his Megaton punch won't be enough to stop the monster, but this unlikely hero may have a few surprises in store for Buu!

title: I Kill No More
summary: I've Stopped Killing!! Majin Buu's Good Boy DeclarationWhile the Z-Fighters continue training in preparation for their battle with Majin Buu, Mr. Satan devises some sneakier plans to take the villain down. But will he even need to carry them out? Is Majin Buu having a change of heart?

title: The Evil of Men
summary: Run Away, Satan!! An Angry Majin Buu EmergesWhen Mr. Satan inspires Majin Buu to give up his evil ways, it seems the professional pretender has really saved the world. But when a deranged madman suddenly spoils Buu's good mood, the pink terror goes on another rampage.

title: Buu Against Buu
summary: Which One Will Win?! A Good and Evil Boo-Boo ConfrontationGood Buu and Evil Buu begin fighting and it seems Evil Buu is much stronger. After a counterattack from Evil Buu the Good Buu turns into chocalate and the Evil Buu eats him and transforms into Super Buu.

title: Empty Planet
summary: A Catastrophe With No Time to Lose!! Earth's Humanity is ExterminatedWhen the new and improved Majin Buu makes a surprise visit to the Lookout to challenge Gotenks, every second becomes a test of survival! And where are Trunks and Goten during the chaos that erupts?... Sound asleep, of course!

title: Time Struggle
summary: The Special Training is a Success!! You're Finished Now, Majin BuuBefore he can unleash his fury on the remaining Z-Fighters, Majin Buu is coaxed into the Hyperbolic Time Chamber. Inside, Trunks and Goten are training diligently, but will they have enough time to perfect their new moves before Majin Buu arrives?

title: Super Moves of Gotenks
summary: The long awaited rematch between Majin Buu and Gotenks begins! But when Gotenks' fighting techniques come up short, he is forced to improvise - resulting in some of the craziest attack moves ever!

title: Trapped In Forever
summary: The battle between Gotenks and Majin Buu rages on inside the Hyperbolic Time Chamber. On the outside, family and friends wait anxiously for Gotenks and Piccolo to reappear. Can they successfully defeat Majin Buu and make it out alive?

title: Feeding Frenzy
summary: Powered by his insatiable hunger, Majin Buu escapes the Hyperbolic Time Chamber, leaving Piccolo and Gotenks trapped inside. Krillin and the gang are forced to fight the monster on their own. Will Buu finally make a meal out of the good guys?

title: Gotenks Is Awesome
summary: Super Saiyan 3 Gotenks continues his fight with Majin Buu, and the Lookout is caught in the crossfire! As Gotenks turns up the power, so does Majin Buu - and by the time it's over, one of them will be in way over his head!

title: Unlucky Break
summary: Gohan continues his training on the World of the Kais. Meanwhile, Gotenks briefly takes the upper hand in the battle with Majin Buu before his techniques begin to fall apart. Will Gohan be ready in time to step in and finish the fight?

title: A Whole New Gohan
summary: When Gotenks' fusion unravels, it appears the end has finally come for Goten and Trunks. But just as things seem their worst, Gohan descends on the scene with his newly awakened powers! Finally, the tables are turning on Majin Buu!

title: Search for Survivors
summary: After being dominated on the battlefield, Majin Buu blows himself up in a desperate attempt to destroy Gohan! But is this just a ploy? Gohan seems to think so! Is Majin Buu plotting an ambush or simply trying to buy a little time?

title: Majin Buu Transforms
summary: Majin Buu reappears, ready for battle, but rather than continue his fight against Gohan, Buu stages a clever deception to absorb Gotenks and Piccolo. With the wisdom of Piccolo and the power of Super Saiyan Gotenks, Buu transforms into "Super Buu!"

title: The Old Kai's Weapon
summary: After absorbing Piccolo and Gotenks, Majin Buu's powers have increased exponentially! Armed with some new tricks, Majin Buu is poised for global destruction. Now that Gohan is alone and weakening, is there anyone who can stop the monster?

title: Ready to Fuse
summary: Goku watches helplessly from Other World as Majin Buu sets his sights on Gohan. Luckily the Old Kai reveals a secret source of power that could save the day. Is Goku ready to bond with his son and put an end to Majin Buu's reign of terror?

title: Union of Rivals
summary: After Majin Buu absorbs Gohan, Goku's plan to join forces with his son is ruined. But an unlikely ally arrives on the scene-Vegeta. Will the Saiyan Prince put aside his differences and agree to merge with Goku?

title: Meet Vegito
summary: The bodies of Goku and Vegeta join to form a new Saiyan warrior. The monster Majin Buu is impressed by the strength of his new opponent, but refuses to take him seriously. Will Majin Buu's arrogance be his undoing?

title: Rip in the Universe
summary: The newly-formed Saiyan warrior Super Vegito matches Majin Buu punch for punch. But the monster's new opponent stirs up an uncontrollable anger within the very heart of the beast. Will Majin Buu's frenzy mean the end of planet Earth?

title: Vegito Downsized
summary: The battle rages on between Vegito and Majin Buu! The Super Saiyan Combo seems to have the fight well in hand. But is Vegito tempting fate by toying with Buu? What terrible tricks does the wily, pink monster still have up his sleeve?

title: The Incredible Fighting Candy
summary: Having been reduced to a coffee-flavored candy, it seems nothing can stop Vegito from being consumed by the evil Majin Buu. But when the gumdrop fights back, Buu realizes that the battle is far from over!

title: The Innards of Buu
summary: When Majin Buu absorbs Vegito, the fused Saiyan separates into Goku and Vegeta once again. Deep within the villain, they reveal their plan to rescue Gohan and the others. Can the duo survive the digestive process and carry out their mission?

title: Mind Trap
summary: Dangers abound as Goku and Vegeta continue their search for Gohan and inside of Majin Buu's body! After meeting some disgusting bedfellows, they finally find what they're looking for as they enter Majin Buu's head!

title: Deadly Vision
summary: Goku and Vegeta reunite the others only to be attacked by Majin Buu! The showdown proves that fighting Buu inside his own head is a mind-bending experience. Can Goku and Vegeta survive in this twisted house of horrors where all is Buu?

title: Evil Kid Buu
summary: When Super Buu begins to mutate once more, Goku and Vegeta make an escape. But what is it that awaits should they manage to escape? The sinister Kid Buu is revealed and proves to be more deadly and psychotic than all previous incarnations.

title: End of Earth
summary: After the chords of attachment to the roly-poly Buu are cut by Vegeta, Majin Buu should mutate into a much weaker form. But instead he gets even stronger! This baffles everyone but Kibito Kai, who discloses Majin Buu's bizarre history!

title: True Saiyans Fight Alone
summary: With Earth erased from existence, Majin Buu begins his search for Goku and Vegeta, leaving entire worlds destroyed in his wake. But when Buu's hunt leads him to the World of the Kais, Goku and Vegeta draw the line!

title: Battle for the Universe Begins
summary: With Majin Buu ready for a fight, Kibito Kai is stunned to see Goku and Vegeta playing a game of Rock, Paper, Scissors! Rather than use the Fusion Technique to join their powers, the duo has decided to fight Buu one at a time!

title: Vegeta's Respect
summary: When Super Saiyan 3 Goku collapses from exhaustion, Vegeta enters the fight, but he doesn't last long! Just as Majin Buu is about to deliver the deathblow, Goku makes a comeback!

title: Minute of Desperation
summary: Goku's powers are fading, and he must end the battle before it's too late! Enter Vegeta, who begins a furious battle with Buu to buy Goku the time needed to gather energy. Outclassed by his opponent, can the Saiyan Prince survive!?

title: Old Buu Emerges
summary: When Vegeta falls, Mr. Satan steps in to take up the challenge! It appears the wannabe hero has signed his death warrant, but when Buu attempts to attack, the monster is crippled by agony!

title: Earth Reborn
summary: As good Majin Buu wages an all-out war against his evil counterpart, Vegeta asks Dende to summon the Dragon on the new Planet Namek. With the good Buu's power dwindling, will Vegeta have enough time to carry out the final phase of his plan?

title: Call to Action
summary: Goku awaits the arrival of the Earthlings collective energy to vitalize the Spirit Bomb, but the energy isn't coming! Have the people of the Earth turned a deaf ear to Vegeta's plea for help at this most critical hour?

title: People of Earth Unite
summary: People of earth are united in order to help Goku to prepare his final attack to defeat Buu and honored Vegeta's sacrifice.

title: Spirit Bomb Triumphant
summary: After the good Buu and Mr. Satan free Vegeta, Goku launches the Spirit Bomb! Unfortunately, the weary Saiyan doesn't have enough power to deliver the blast, and Buu sends it right back at him! Will Goku be destroyed by his own attack?

title: Celebrations with Majin Buu
summary: When Goku and his companions return to Earth after defeating Majin Buu, they are welcomed with open arms. But nobody is happy to see the good Buu! Can Mr. Satan's pink pal manage to fit into society? Or is he destined to become an outcast?

title: He's Always Late
summary: Goku is late for his own party... he's busy looking after some pterodactyl eggs.

title: Granddaughter Pan
summary: Grandpa Goku! I Am Pan!!Goku intends to participate in the World Martial Arts Tournament. It seems a mysterious fighter has caught his eye. Of course, Vegeta, Trunks, Goten, and Pan will fight as well.

title: Buu's Reincarnation
summary: I Am Uub! Now 10 Years Old, the Former Majin?!The World Martial Arts Tournament gets underway. Goku is paired up with the mystery fighter who Goku claims is the reincarnation of Majin Buu.

title: Goku's Next Journey
summary: Even Stronger!! Goku's Dream is Super-HugeGoku takes Uub on as his student, and bids goodbye to his family and friends as he embarks on a new adventure.
